title: The Last Boy Scout
about: A washed-up private eye and a banned quarterback stumble onto a plot to buy legal sports gambling, and the trail ends back at the stadium.
cue: Serve the brisket rolls when Jimmy throws the game ball at the senator.

Beef frank, slow chilli, cheddar, onion.How to make it250g beef mince1 brown onion, finely diced2 garlic cloves, crushed2 tsp chilli powder1 tsp ground cumin400g tin crushed tomatoes8 beef frankfurts8 split-top bread rolls100g cheddar, grated1/2 white onion, finely dicedBrown the mince with the onion and garlic.Add the chilli powder, cumin and tomatoes and simmer until thick.Grill the franks until blistered.Fill the toasted rolls and top with chilli, cheddar and raw onion.Game-ball soft pretzels with beer cheeseJimmy throws the game ball at the senator. Chewy salted pretzels, sharp cheddar dip.How to make it500g plain flour7g sachet dried yeast1 tbsp brown sugar300ml warm water3 tbsp bicarbonate of soda1 egg, beaten1 tbsp sea salt flakes30g butter1 tbsp plain flour, extra185ml lager200g sharp cheddar, grated1 tsp American mustardMix the flour, yeast, sugar, a teaspoon of salt and the water and knead until smooth, then leave to double.Roll into 8 ropes and twist into pretzels.Boil each for 30 seconds in 2 litres of water with the bicarbonate of soda, then drain.Brush with egg, sprinkle with salt and bake at 220°C until deep brown.Melt the butter, stir in the extra flour, whisk in the lager, then melt in the cheddar and mustard.Peanuts in the shellThrown up to the cheap seats.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.Hot StandMarcone's six-million-dollar brisket rollsBaynard wants six million from Marcone. Smoky brisket, pickled onion, slaw, soft roll.How to make it1.5kg beef brisket2 tbsp brown sugar1 tbsp smoked paprika2 tsp garlic powder1 tsp ground black pepper250ml smoky barbecue sauce250ml beef stock1 red onion, thinly sliced125ml apple cider vinegar1/4 green cabbage, finely shredded3 tbsp whole-egg mayonnaise6 soft white rollsRub the brisket with the sugar, paprika, garlic powder, pepper and 2 teaspoons of salt.Sit it in a roasting dish with the stock, cover tightly and cook at 150°C until it pulls apart.Meanwhile cover the onion with the vinegar and a pinch of sugar and salt to pickle, and toss the cabbage with the mayonnaise.Slice or pull the brisket, toss with the barbecue sauce and some pan juices.Pile into the rolls with slaw and pickled onion.SweetsLeave-the-ice-alone shaved iceJoe likes ice. Shaved ice, cherry and lime syrups, condensed milk.How to make it250g frozen pitted cherries200g caster sugar3 limes6 cups ice4 tbsp sweetened condensed milkSimmer the cherries with half the sugar and 100ml water until syrupy, then strain and cool.Simmer the rest of the sugar with the lime zest and juice and 100ml water for 2 minutes, then cool.Shave or blitz the ice to snow in a strong blender.Pile into cups, pour over both syrups and drizzle with condensed milk.Cold DrinksJoe's whiskey, with iceJimmy makes Joe spill his whiskey.
